message.content:
1.  **Color Palette:** Neutral off-white background (`#EAE8E4`), deep charcoal text (`#2C2C2C`), vibrant accent blocks (Mustard `#EAD669`, Red `#E03C31`, Lavender `#BFA6E2`, Olive `#8A9970`).
    **Typography:** Bold, geometric Sans-Serif (likely Inter or similar). Massive headline size (~80-100px), sentence case. Small, clean UI font for navigation and footer.
    **Layout & Composition:** Asymmetric split layout. Left column: Heavy typographic weight (40% width). Right column: Staggered masonry-style image grid with consistent gutters. High whitespace around the main container.
    **Visual Effects:** Flat, vector-like photography style. Solid color backgrounds for images create "cutout" effects. No heavy shadows or gradients; relies on color blocking.
    **Motion Cues:** Suggests a "bento grid" reveal where images might stagger in. Cursor likely triggers subtle scaling on the image cards.
    **Emotional Feeling:** Playful, modern, structured, creative, approachable.

2.  **Color Palette:** Minimalist palette. Light gray background (`#EBE9E5`), Dark gray text (`#333333`). Beige block (`#D6CFC5`) in corner. Tiny colorful thumbnails (Purple, Yellow, Green) inline.
    **Typography:** Heavy Sans-Serif headline, centered alignment. Large body copy size (~60px) acting as a hero statement. Inline images integrated into the baseline of the text.
    **Layout & Composition:** Centered, single-column editorial layout. Extreme focus on typography as the primary visual element. Generous vertical padding.
    **Visual Effects:** Inline thumbnail replacement (images replacing words like "furniture", "ingredients"). Clean, flat aesthetic.
    **Motion Cues:** Text likely reveals word-by-word or line-by-line. The inline images probably pop or fade in to replace the text.
    **Emotional Feeling:** Sustainable, clean, honest, minimalist, thoughtful.

3.  **Color Palette:** Cool, atmospheric tones. Deep slate blue/teal (`#3F5A68`) dominating the ice cave. High contrast white text (`#FFFFFF`). Accent red from the jackets (`#D93B29`).
    **Typography:** Mix of elegant Serif (for the subhead "Luxury and adventure...") and massive, bold Sans-Serif (for "ANTARCTICA"). All caps for the main title.
    **Layout & Composition:** Full-bleed cinematic background image. Typography layered on top using a clear visual hierarchy (small top-left, massive bottom-center). Navigation bar is transparent/floating.
    **Visual Effects:** Parallax depth implied by the ice texture. Subtle grain/noise overlay likely present for texture. High-definition photography.
    **Motion Cues:** The "Watch Film" button suggests video playback. Likely a slow zoom (Ken Burns effect) on the background image.
    **Emotional Feeling:** Epic, remote, adventurous, cold, luxurious.

4.  **Color Palette:** Bright, natural landscape colors. Sky blue (`#6BA0BF`), rocky brown (`#8C5E4A`), white snow fog. Vibrant Orange CTA tab (`#F26522`).
    **Typography:** Massive Sans-Serif ("ANTARCTICA") with heavy blur/glassmorphism effect applied. Small Serif subhead visible top left.
    **Layout & Composition:** Full-screen panoramic image. Vertical grid lines visible (suggesting a slider or transition mechanism). Fixed side-tab navigation ("How it works").
    **Visual Effects:** **Heavy Gaussian Blur** on the main headline text, creating a "frozen" or "foggy" glassmorphism look. Fog/mist overlay at the bottom blending into white.
    **Motion Cues:** The blurred text suggests it is transitioning out or reacting to scroll position (opacity/blur shift). Vertical lines suggest a sliding transition between scenes.
    **Emotional Feeling:** Ethereal, vast, transitional, mysterious, pristine.

5.  **Color Palette:** Dark mode tech aesthetic. Deep navy/black background (`#11151C`). Neon Magenta/Pink accent (`#FF3388`) for key actions and emphasis. White/Light Gray text (`#F5F5F5`).
    **Typography:** Monospace or technical Sans-Serif for navigation (uppercase, spaced out). Ultra-light weight for "infrastructure that" vs. Bold/Pink for "scales". High contrast in font weights.
    **Layout & Composition:** Split screen (approx 30/70 or 40/60). Left side is branding/headline. Right side is negative space with supporting text and CTAs aligned bottom-right.
    **Visual Effects:** Gradient text on the word "scales" (Pink to Purple). Glassmorphism or translucent dark header background.
    **Motion Cues:** Typewriter effect or glitch animation likely on the text. The "Sign Up" button has a high-energy hover state implied by its color.
    **Emotional Feeling:** Technical, futuristic, powerful, sleek, high-performance.
